app.name: AI Explained
app.tagline: A calm guide to AI at work.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: Three quick questions help us suggest where to start. Answer any, all or none.

feeling.question: How do you feel about AI right now?

used.question: Have you used an AI tool?

time.question: How much time do you have each week?

feelingReply.curious: Curiosity is the best place to start.
feelingReply.overwhelmed: That makes sense. There is a lot of noise. We will keep things small and clear.
feelingReply.sceptical: A little doubt is healthy. We will show you what AI is bad at, too.
feelingReply.behind: You are not behind. Most people are just starting.

timeReply.five: Five minutes a week is enough. One lesson every week or two is a fine pace.
timeReply.fifteen: That is plenty. About two lessons a week, with no rush.
timeReply.more: Lovely. Go at whatever pace feels good.

welcome.usedOften: You already use AI, so the first lessons may feel familiar. They are short, and you can skip ahead whenever you like.

learn.title: Learn
learn.intro: AI is new for almost everyone. Take it one small step at a time.
learn.finishedBody: Come back to any lesson, any time.

lesson.quickCheckIntro: No score. Just a way to see what stuck. Pick again as often as you like.

practice.title: Practice
practice.intro: Try these in an AI tool you already have. A tool approved by your employer is best.
practice.safetyBody: Use made-up or non-sensitive text only. Follow your employer's AI policy. Each exercise gives you sample text, so you never need real work data.
